sentences.text:
This appeal is filed by claimants under section 173(1) of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 (for short,
'the M.V. Act') aggrieved by the judgment and award dated 23.09.2022 in MVC No.318/2022, on the file of the Motor Vehicle Accident Claims Tribunal, Mudhol-XIV (for short 'the Tribunal), whereby,
the Tribunal awarded an amount of Rs.27,49,800/- as compensation to the claimants.

entities.text: Motor Vehicle Accident Claims Tribunal, Mudhol-XIV
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2. For the sake of convenience, the parties are referred to as they are referred to in the claim petition before the Tribunal.
3. The claim petition was filed by the claimants seeking compensation of Rs.80,00,000/- on account of the death of Sri.Tippanna S/o Sadashiv Madar, who died in the accident on 11.06.2021.

The deceased- Sri.Tippanna, was proceeding on his Ape NC: 2024:KHC-D:8149 Auto (three wheeler)
bearing registered No.KA- 48/8213 from Jeeragal village to Mudhol and the claimant Uday @
Mahesh S/o Mahadev Hosur in MVC No.316/2021
was sitting in the said Auto.

The Auto came near Sai Cement Briks Factory in Mudhol city at that time, the driver of Tanker bearing registered No.KA-17/AA-0900 came from Mudhol side to Lokapur road in a rash and negligent manner and dashed to the Ape Auto.
Due to the said impact, the driver of Auto and Uday sustained severe injuries.
Immediately, they were shifted to Dr.Uday Naik Private Hospital at Mudhol for treatment.
Later, Tippanna the driver of Auto succumbed to the accidental injuries.

4. Hence, the claimants filed this petition under Section 166 of the M.V.Act, on the ground that claimant No.1 is the wife of the deceased-Tippanna, claimant Nos.2 to 4 are the children of deceased- Tippanna and claimants Nos.5 and 6 are the father and mother of the deceased-Tippanna.
Deceased was NC: 2024:KHC-D:8149 earning a sum of Rs.5,00,000/- per year and he used to earn Rs.1,000 per day and Rs.30,000/- per month before his death.
The claimants have lost sole bread earner in the family and they have sought for enhancement of compensation.

5. Heard the learned counsel appearing for the claimants and respondent No.2-Insurance Company and perused the judgment and award of the Tribunal.
6.

As there is no dispute regarding the death of deceased - Tippanna, who died in a road traffic accident that occurred on 11.06.2021, due to rash and negligent driving of the Tipper bearing registration No.KA-17/AA-0900 by its driver and liability on the Insurer of the Tipper, the only point that arises for Courts consideration in the appeal is:
"Whether the quantum of compensation awarded by the Tribunal is just and reasonable or does it call for enhancement?"
Smt. Rukmini W/O Tippanna Madar vs S S G Transport on 12 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/38704012/

sentences.text: After hearing the learned counsel appearing NC: 2024:KHC-D:8149 for the parties and perusing the judgment and award of the Tribunal, I am of the view that the compensation awarded by the Tribunal is not just and reasonable, it is on the lower side and hence it is required to be enhanced.

8. The claimants in order to prove their case, examined claimant No.1 as PW.2 and r e l i e d u p o n 1 4 d o c u m e n t s namely Ex.P1 to Ex.P14.
9.
On behalf of respondent, Sri.Srikant S/o Bakkappa Bazar, was examined as RW.1 and produced documents at Ex.R-1-Authorisation latter and Ex.R.2- Policy.

The very fact that the deceased was proceeding towards Mudhol City and at that time, the driver of Tipper came in rash and negligent manner and dashed to the Ape Auto of deceased-Tippanna is not in dispute.
Hence, he sustained injuries and succumbed to the accidental injuries in the hospital.
10. The claimants have stated that prior to his death, the deceased-Tippanna was running Auto and NC: 2024:KHC-D:8149 his monthly income was at Rs.30,000/- per month.
A part from oral and documentary evidence of PW.2, the claimants have not furnished any documents to prove that the deceased was earning of Rs.30,000/- per month.
11. Under such circumstances, the Tribunal considered the notional income of the deceased at Rs.11,000/-, however, the observations made by the Tribunal in this regard is not correct.
Considering the age of the deceased as 27 years, t h e year of accident as 2021 and his notional income is re- assessed at Rs.14,250/- per month in place of Rs.11,000/- as arrived by the Tribunal.
12. The claimants are wife, children and parents of deceased-Tippanna.

Therefore, 1/4th of his income has to be deducted towards his 'personal expenses' and 3/4th of his income has to be taken towards his family contribution and the multiplier applicable to his age group is '17'.

Therefore, the 'loss of dependency' NC: 2024:KHC-D:8149 works out to Rs.30,52,350/- (14,250/- x 12 x17 x 3/4th which comes to Rs.21,80,250/- + 40% =Rs.8,72,100/-) as against Rs.27,49,800/- awarded by the tribunal.

13. In view of the law laid down by the Supreme Court in the case of MAGMA GENERAL INSURANCE COMPANY LIMITED Vs. NANU RAM ALIAS CHUHRU RAM AND OTHERS reported in 2018 ACJ 2782 (SC), claimant No.1, wife of the deceased is entitled for a compensation of Rs.40,000/- under the head of 'loss of spousal consortium' and claimant Nos.2 to 4 are the children of deceased-Tippanna a r e entitled for a compensation of Rs.40,000/- each under the head 'loss of parental consortium' and claimants Nos.5 and 6 are the parents of the deceased-Tippanna are entitled for compensation of Rs.40,000/- each under the head of 'loss of consortium'.

entities.text: MAGMA GENERAL INSURANCE COMPANY LIMITED Vs. NANU RAM ALIAS CHUHRU RAM AND OTHERS reported in 2018 ACJ 2782 (SC)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 14. The accident is of the year 2021.

In view of the ratio laid down in the case of NATIONAL NC:
2024:KHC-D:8149 INSURANCE COMPANY LIMITED -VS- PRANAY SETHI AND OTHERS reported in (2017) 16 SCC 680, wherein, the Hon'ble Apex Court enhanced compensation on conventional heads, on percentage basis once in every three years and the enhancement should be at the rate of 10% in a span of three years.
